entries.title: Reducing synthetic markers makes some SDF false facts indistinguishable from real knowledge
entries.summary: Synthetic document finetuning (SDF) documents carry features that set them apart from pretraining text. Linear probes on middle-layer activations use these markers to separate SDF false facts from pretraining-acquired facts. Reducing the markers removes that gap for some subtly implausible facts. Applying RPO then strengthens the false facts, but overtraining is detectable.
entries.analysis: Single post; weakens probe-based detection of implanted beliefs.

entries.title: MATS x CG Pitch Week: what happened
entries.summary: The Q2 2026 pilot ran 38 expressions of interest, 17 applying teams and 15 pitches. It awarded $4.3M across six grants: five org-founding and two independent research. Funding did not correlate with observable founder traits. Successful pitches had mature, evaluable ideas.
